attempts.prompt:
Draw the final Wu Yi (吴懿) lineart animation close-up for frame 313. Pure white background, thin clean gray-black contours, no color or solid shadow. Landscape 1920x1080 target.
The SECOND input, block_000313.png, controls the entire current pose and composition. Its actual drawing viewport is x360..1560,y90..990: expand that action view into the final image without its explanatory layout. Preserve the depicted joint positions, wrist orientation, finger spread, foreshortening, boat position and border clipping. Turn construction boxes into natural anatomical forms, not traced box hands. Do not center or rearrange the hand or boat for beauty.
CURRENT FRAME ACTION: The palm is EMPTY. There is NO BOAT ANYWHERE IN THIS FRAME, not even a fragment, because it has already left through the upper-left boundary. Only a graceful open five-finger hand and sleeve remain. Wrist is lower-right of palm; palm and four fingers point diagonally UPPER LEFT, thumb nearly vertical; the forearm slopes steeply down-right into a wide rounded sleeve exiting the LOWER-RIGHT edge. This turned-up empty-hand pose follows the second reference exactly. Do not draw any object from third reference.
The FIRST input, wy_full_master_v1.png, gives Wu Yi's costume only: a graceful adult woman's hand emerges from a broad soft rounded robe cuff, with inner cuff band and restrained botanical curved embroidery. Natural five fingers (one thumb, four fingers), soft skin contours and a few joint creases. The sleeve continues along this frame's forearm angle. No black arm guard.
The THIRD input, frame303, gives only the fine line quality, hand character, sleeve ornament vocabulary and same carved small nutshell boat with low arched cabin. Its actual hand/boat layout is a different earlier frame; do not retain that static pose. Preserve this same boat design wherever the target block still includes it.
Only the hand, sleeve and any visible part of the small boat specified by the SECOND input. Do not draw a face, body, second hand, background, text, numbers, labels, axes, border, geometric construction lines or montage. No glowing effects, sails, extra props or windup. It is gentle palm release of a magical small object. Output only this one complete frame.
